description: Build a walkable 3D WORLD (Gaussian splat, World Labs Marble) from ONE location picture (costs credits — exact price via get_cost: true). Source: a location board's time variant (loc_id + variante) OR a gallery image of the project (quell_bild_id). stufe 'entwurf' is a cheap draft (about a minute), 'voll' the full world (5-15 min). ASYNCHRONOUS: returns welt_id; poll lab_welt_status. When done, open the studio link, place a camera and save angles — they land in the project gallery and work as seed_image_url for lab_generate. The world only holds near the spot the picture was taken from: reverse shots from inside the room work, flying through walls does not.

get_cost.description: Free: the exact price of this operation; nothing is built or charged. Name it to the person before the real run.

loc_id.description: Location board id (from lab_list_locations); needs variante

project_id.description: Project id (from lab_list_projects) — the world is filed in this project's gallery

quell_bild_id.description: Instead of a board: a finished gallery image of THIS project

text_prompt.description: Optional description of the place; for a board its prompt prefix is used when left out

variante.description: Which picture of the board: a time variant or its 360° panorama

name: lab_welt
title: Location → Welt
